items.title: Java Visibility and Exposures
items.summary: Hidden weaknesses in unpatched Java installations expand the organizational attack surface and expose the environment to severe operational disruptions. Visualizing impacted assets allows the organization to grasp how unmanaged applications increase overall risk exposure. A resilient defense posture requires continuous awareness of deployed infrastructure to prevent adversaries from exploiting network vulnerabilities. The Java Visibility and Exposures report resolves these challenges by transforming complex scanning data into accessible visual formats, guiding the risk manager to proactively identify hidden flaws and secure vulnerable assets.
